+# This file is part of Ansible
+#
+# Ansible is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
+# it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
+# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or

+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_routes():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'local 192.168.1.42/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link\n'
+            'local 192.168.0.1/32 dev eth0 scope host\n'
+            'local invalid dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+        (0, 'local 2001:0DB8:0:0::42/64 dev lo\n'
+            'local ::1/128 dev lo\n'
+            'local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[0][0][0] == [
+        '/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'scope', 'host']
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1][0][0] == [
+        '/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'scope', 'host']
+    module.warn.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_route_failure_keeps_other_family():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (1, '', 'unsupported'),
+        (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Could not collect locally reachable ipv4 routes')
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_fact_is_collected_and_selectable():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    with patch.object(network, 'get_default_interfaces', return_value=({}, {})), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_interfaces_info', return_value=({}, {
+                'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []})), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_locally_reachable_ips', return_value={
+                'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}):
+        facts = network.populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector().fact_ids
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_fact_without_ip_command():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    facts = LinuxNetwork(module).populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once()
